strings.original: CARLOS — lower your costs, own your software

strings.text: A software architecture for building apps that are cost-effective to run, continuously available and replicated, lightweight to deploy, built on an open and secure foundation.
strings.original: 🤖 An application architecture extracted from five systems that kept rebuilding it. One person, one process, one database that sleeps into a bucket. Cost-efficient, Available, Replicated, Lightweight, Open, Secure.

strings.text: Lower your costs. Own your software.
strings.original: Lower your costs. Own your software.

strings.text: Isolate user data from other users, with single-process apps that scale to zero, deployed on a system built on single-binary processes as simple as the apps themselves.
strings.original: Every person gets their own process and their own database. Idle apps sleep into a bucket and wake on the next request. The whole system is one static binary you can run yourself.

strings.original: Idle instances stop running and park in object storage.

strings.text: Millisecond wake times with host failover.
strings.original: A request for a sleeping instance wakes it and waits.

strings.text: Every database streams to object storage from the first byte.

strings.text: Static, single-process binaries with embedded databases, system managed.

strings.text: Open source, open infrastructure, and open data
